reason: A macOS desktop companion that displays an always-on-top animated pet whose states reflect local DSH agent sessions, with skin selection and CLI controls.

summaries.zh: 一款 macOS 桌宠插件，会根据本地 DSH agent 会话状态切换表情，并提供置顶窗口、皮肤选择和命令行控制。
summaries.en: A macOS desktop pet that changes expressions based on local DSH agent session states and provides an always-on-top window, skin selection, and CLI controls.

capabilities: Runs a macOS always-on-top desktop window
Reflects local DSH session activity through pet states
Provides draggable, clickable, context-menu, and CLI controls
Supports selectable skins and a bundled skill for generating custom skin assets from an image
